title: Nexus PatternSlot
description: One named slot a pattern package declares for compose-time binding. The declaration is data: binding a slot, and checking that every required slot is bound, are runtime compose steps.

name.description: Slot name. Unique within one package manifest; non-empty.

kind.description: What a binding supplies for this slot: a string value, an asset id, or a capability id.

required.description: Whether compose must bind this slot before the package can be used.
